sv.title: Domare stoppar Trumps plan
sv.summary: Donald Trump tillkännagav en ”historisk renovering” av en golfbana i Washington DC som han kallar ”den värsta i världen”. Nu har en domare blockerat Trumps planer, skriver Fox News.

en.title: Judge stops Trump's plan
en.summary: Donald Trump announced a "historic renovation" of a golf course in Washington DC, which he calls "the worst in the world". Now a judge has blocked Trump's plans, writes Fox News.
